# ice40_sdram_node: U3 changed to the 144-pin TQFP iCE40 (source and placement only)

No export, routing or KiCad file was produced or edited. Everything below comes from `synth_validate`, `synth_describe_placement` and `synth_place_with_hints` (run_routing=false).

## Part identities

| Ref | Part | Package / identity |
|---|---|---|
| U3 | `ice40hx4k_tq144` (user registry) | Lattice ICE40HX4K-TQ144, symbol FPGA_Lattice:ICE40HX4K-TQ144, footprint Package_QFP:TQFP-144_20x20mm_P0.5mm |
| U4 | `is42s16400j_sdram` | IS42S16400J-7TLI, TSOP-II-54 (unchanged) |
| U5 | `w25q128jvsiq_208mil` | unchanged |
| J1, J2, U1, U2 | unchanged | |

Source changes: U3 now `ice40hx4k_tq144` with `escape { off }`; `requires via_in_pad` removed (nothing else needs it); six-layer stackup and `manufacturer "jlc-advanced"` kept. U3 also has a hard `region: centre` hint. Two parts were added: C20 and C24 (100 nF, 0402, +3V3). The TQ144 has 8 vccio pads and the BGA design had 5 vccio balls with 6 capacitors, so C20 and C24 give every vccio pad a capacitor.

## Supply arithmetic

- **vccio_0, vccio_0_2, vccio_1, vccio_1_2, vccio_2, vccio_2_2, vccio_3, vccio_3_2 (8 pads)** are on +3V3. The SDRAM and flash are 3.3 V LVCMOS parts.
- **vcc, vcc_2, vcc_3, vcc_4 (4 pads)** are on +1V2, from the TLV70012.
- **vccpll0 / vccpll1** are on VCCPLL, which is +1V2 through ferrite L1 with C21, C22 and C23.
- **gnd, gnd_2..gnd_9 (9 pads), gndpll0, gndpll1** are on GND. All duplicated pads are connected.
- **vcc_spi** is on +3V3 (flash and header are 3.3 V).
- **vpp_2v5** is on +3V3, the same as the BGA design. This is not verified. The part description does not state the vpp_2v5 range and I had no datasheet access. From memory the Lattice iCE40 LP/HX datasheet allows about 2.3 V to 3.46 V on VPP_2V5, so 3.3 V would be inside it. That figure must be checked against DS1040 before release. If the limit is 2.5 V +/-5 %, the board has no 2.5 V rail and this pin needs one added.
- **vpp_fast** (pin 109) is unconnected. **nc pins** (35, 36, 50, 51, 58, 77, 133) are unconnected.
- **iob_103_cbsel0 / iob_104_cbsel1** (pins 63, 64) are tied to GND (boot-image select 0), as before.

## Pin assignment

Pin numbering is counter-clockwise from the top-left corner: 1-36 left, 37-72 bottom, 73-108 right, 109-144 top. The SDRAM sits at the left of the FPGA, so the bus uses the left-side IOL pads (pins 1-34) in numeric order. The ten overflow address bits use the top-left pads next to the left-side corner.

| Net | Pin | Pin name |
|---|---|---|
| SD_DQ0 | 1 | iol_2a |
| SD_DQ1 | 2 | iol_2b |
| SD_DQ2 | 3 | iol_3a |
| SD_DQ3 | 4 | iol_3b |
| SD_DQ4 | 7 | iol_4a |
| SD_DQ5 | 8 | iol_4b |
| SD_DQ6 | 9 | iol_5a |
| SD_DQ7 | 10 | iol_5b |
| SD_DQ8 | 11 | iol_8a |
| SD_DQ9 | 12 | iol_8b |
| SD_DQ10 | 15 | iol_10a |
| SD_DQ11 | 16 | iol_10b |
| SD_DQ12 | 17 | iol_12a |
| SD_DQ13 | 18 | iol_12b |
| SD_DQ14 | 19 | iol_13a |
| SD_DQ15 | 20 | iol_13b_gbin7 |
| SD_CK_F (to RS1) | 21 | iol_14a_gbin6 (global-buffer pad) |
| SD_LDQM | 22 | iol_14b |
| SD_WE_F (to RS5) | 23 | iol_17a |
| SD_CAS_F (to RS4) | 24 | iol_17b |
| SD_RAS_F (to RS3) | 25 | iol_18a |
| SD_CS_F (to RS2) | 26 | iol_18b |
| SD_BA0 | 28 | iol_23a |
| SD_BA1 | 29 | iol_23b |
| SD_UDQM | 31 | iol_24a |
| SD_CKE_F (to RS6) | 32 | iol_24b |
| SD_A10 | 33 | iol_25a |
| SD_A11 | 34 | iol_25b |
| SD_A0 | 144 | iot_222 |
| SD_A1 | 143 | iot_221 |
| SD_A2 | 142 | iot_220 |
| SD_A3 | 141 | iot_219 |
| SD_A4 | 139 | iot_217 |
| SD_A5 | 138 | iot_216 |
| SD_A6 | 137 | iot_215 |
| SD_A7 | 136 | iot_214 |
| SD_A8 | 135 | iot_213 |
| SD_A9 | 134 | iot_212 |
| SPI_SS_B | 71 | iob_108_ss |
| SPI_SCK | 70 | iob_107_sck |
| SPI_SDI | 68 | iob_106_sdi |
| SPI_SDO | 67 | iob_105_sdo |
| CRESET_B | 66 | creset |
| CDONE | 65 | cdone |
| LED_USER_R | 74 | ior_110 (was iob_56; moved to the right side next to the LED block) |

Notes on the assignment:
- The clock is on iol_14a_gbin6, a global-buffer input pad (the part marks gbin6 and gbin7 on the left side).
- Bus order against the SDRAM: the data bus is contiguous in numeric order on the FPGA, but the TSOP-II-54 has data and address pins on both of its columns (DQ0-7, LDQM, WE, CAS, RAS, CS, BA0, BA1, A10 and A0-A3 on pins 1-27; the rest on pins 28-54). Half the bus therefore faces away from the FPGA, and crossing-free routing is not guaranteed. Routing was not run, so I have not checked it.
- A0-A9 are on the top-left pads, next to the left-side corner, rather than on the left side. The left side has 28 usable IOL pads and the bus needs 38 signals.

## Placement

Sidecar: `ice40_sdram_node.placement.layout.toml` (every part positioned, priority hard).

- FPGA U3 at (40, 25) mm. SDRAM U4 at (16.5, 25) mm to its left.
- Series resistors RS1-RS6 in a column at x = 24.5 mm between U4 and the FPGA's left pads.
- Decoupling capacitors one per power pin on the side of that pin: bottom row (vcc_2, vccio_2, vccpll0, vccio_2_2), right (vccio_1, vcc_3, vccio_1_2), top (vccio_0_2, vccpll1, vccio_0, vcc_4), left (vccio_3, vcc, vccio_3_2). L1 and C23 sit under the bottom row.
- U4 capacitors C30-C37 in rows above and below U4.
- USB-C J1 on the left edge at the bottom-left, rotation 270. Power chain (R2, R3, F1, D1, Q1, R1, C1, U1, U2) along the bottom-left.
- Flash U5 and header J2 at the bottom right; J2 on the bottom edge, rotated 90.
- LED block (R20-R22, D2-D4, Q2) right of the FPGA.
- Mounting holes H1 at (3.5, 3.5) and H2 at (64, 63): opposite corners. Test points are kept, as are the LEDs.

### Placement review (`synth_place_with_hints`, run_routing=false, final run)

- `visual_review.requires_revision`: **false**, score 100, no findings.
- `synth_describe_placement` fitness score 63.4 (support_distance and mating_inset gates failing).
- Remaining functional warnings, none fixed:
  - C4, C5 are 8 mm and 10 mm from U1 vout (limit 6 mm).
  - TP1 is 7 mm from Q1.s (limit 5 mm).
  - RS2-RS6 are 8.1 to 11.0 mm from U4. The review wants them beside U4 because it measures to part centres. The task wants them at the FPGA end, and they are 3 to 4 mm from the FPGA pads. I left them at the FPGA end. This is a real conflict.
  - About 20 rail-capacitor-distance warnings (C4 27 mm, C6 and C5 26 mm, C7 17 mm, C18 15 mm, C13 14 mm, and others). I could not tell from the output whether the distance rule measures to the pad or the part centre. I did not resolve them.
- Parts with hard `near` hints in the `.synth` (C4, C5, TP1 and others) were moved by the placer from their sidecar position, so the sidecar does not fully control them.
- J1 is now flush (the review no longer names it).

### Board size and fill: not measured

- `synth_describe_placement` reports a 73.0 x 69.4 mm board (5,066 mm2). The final `synth_place_with_hints` reports 82.45 x 80.1 mm. These disagree and I do not know which one the exporter would use.
- No tool I used reports courtyard fill. My estimate of the total courtyard area is about 1,400 mm2, which is about 28 % of 5,066 mm2. That is a guess from package sizes, not a measurement, and it is below the 30 % target. 30 % of 5,066 mm2 needs about 1,520 mm2. A fill figure needs `layout_metrics.py` on an exported board, and I was told not to export.
